expectations.text: States that once a tag moderator removes a tag the author cannot add it back
expectations.evidence: "You can't re-add it. The playbook says: 'A tag moderator can remove a tag; the author cannot re-add it.'"

expectations.text: Suggests #news (with a brief summary and source) or #showdev as the tag for a release post
expectations.evidence: "Use `#news` for the release, with a brief summary and the source link. `#showdev` is the other launch tag."

expectations.text: Suggests rewriting future release posts into JavaScript-focused technical content if they want the tag
expectations.evidence: "Consider making the post earn #javascript... add real JavaScript content... one tutorial-style section... a runnable code sample."

expectations.text: Mentions that tag rules live in each tag's sidebar or submission guidelines and should be checked before posting
expectations.evidence: "Read the live #javascript sidebar rules. I don't have the exact wording, so check it before deciding."
